name: semctx
description: Semantic code search over your repo — hybrid dense+lexical retrieval (reranked) served by the semctx engine, exposed as MCP tools (search_codebase, find_definition, find_references, file_outline, expand_chunk, ...), a codebase-retrieval skill, a prompt-context hook that injects likely-relevant code per prompt, and a PreToolUse nudge that steers built-in Grep/Glob/find toward the semctx tools in indexed repos.
